aggregate_rule: Every selected appearance feature and scene/reference/medium gate must be PASS for this arm to qualify. Any FAIL or UNOBSERVABLE makes the arm unqualified; do not drop failed agent-selected details after rendering.

gates.PASS: A visibly connected opaque fringe covers one entire eye; the other eye is separately visible. The concealment is made by hair, not shadow, eyewear or an unrelated object.
gates.FAIL: Both eyes remain visible, both eyes are covered, or the apparent eye cover has another cause.
gates.UNOBSERVABLE: The scale, crop, view or blur does not allow hair continuity and eye concealment to be inspected.

gates.PASS: At least one short curved hair tuft rises distinctly above the crown with a readable separation from the main hair mass.
gates.FAIL: The crown is smooth, only a diagonal fringe is present, or an indistinct general windblown edge substitutes for a separate tuft.
gates.UNOBSERVABLE: The crown is cropped, too small, merged with background or blurred.

gates.PASS: A discrete guard visibly continues from the forearm across the wrist onto the dorsal hand to near the knuckle roots, with separate exposed fingers.
gates.FAIL: The guard ends at the wrist, only a glove or sleeve cuff appears, or the hand-back continuation is missing.
gates.UNOBSERVABLE: Hands are cropped, concealed, blurred or the hand-back orientation cannot be inspected.

gates.PASS: Multiple individually bounded actual open apertures occur between intersecting textile strands, with skin visible through the empty spaces.
gates.FAIL: A printed grid, solid fabric, smoothly translucent sheet or unresolved net-like texture replaces open apertures.
gates.UNOBSERVABLE: Sleeves are too small, hidden, blurred or underexposed to distinguish holes from printed marks.

gates.PASS: A telescope or unmistakable observatory instrument enclosure and snowy mountain view belong to a spatially coherent facility scene.
gates.FAIL: Only a generic mountain portrait or generic room appears, or the equipment and outside view are spatially incompatible.
gates.UNOBSERVABLE: Essential facility/background components cannot be inspected.

gates.PASS: The subject visibly attends toward a recorder/paper trace with a coherent nearby finger or hand placement.
gates.FAIL: No readable recorder/trace relationship exists, or ownership/contact is anatomically inconsistent.
gates.UNOBSERVABLE: The recorder, gaze or hand contact cannot be inspected.

gates.PASS: The visible eye, nose, lips and lower face contour retain recognizable corresponding exterior form from the reference at useful scale. The covered eye remains intentionally unassessed.
gates.FAIL: Visible corresponding face components are materially transformed into a different contour or generic stylized form.
gates.UNOBSERVABLE: Visible corresponding facial parts lack enough scale/clarity for a fair comparison.

gates.PASS: The saved image reads as a photograph with coherent material, light and skin behavior.
gates.FAIL: It primarily reads as drawing, anime, painting or stylized CGI.

control_calibration: Describe actual image impression before consulting intended control labels; perceived expression and technical binding are separate.
user_acceptance: Not assessed by this technical test.
